anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly for every fact: Case A re-polls once and exits with verdict `stuck - merge state unknown` with usage rounds 1 / syncs 2 untouched and no sync or watch; Case B exits `stuck - run record unreadable` on the ENOENT, recreates nothing, searches no other record, infers nothing from chat, and withholds every write-backed row; Case C reports `GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies`, keeps reviewDecision as a locator only, names no rule and offers no approve row; and all three use the shared obstacle template with stop recommended last, evidence demoted to a hint line, no wait row and merge withheld. Before failed each fact because its menus came from the old per-action model: A and C rendered `fixable` verdicts with a recommended `wait` row and a numeric `show evidence` row, and B rendered `fixable - merge state unknown` rather than a record-unreadable obstacle. Nothing in After regressed a fact Before kept. One wording nit to consider for the deliver rows in A and C: they promise `add 10 to each cap` even though usage 1/10 and 2/10 is nowhere near exhaustion; if cumulative extension is meant only for the cap obstacle, phrase the deliver row as a plain resume (no cap change) so a reader cannot take the unknown/blocked obstacle as a cap-extension event.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves every fact from fails to holds. Before labelled all three checkpoints `fixable`, offered an ordinary `wait` row recommended first in A and C, and exposed `show evidence` as a numeric row with `stop` not recommended, so none of the stuck/obstacle facts held. After renders `not ready - stuck - merge state unknown`, `stuck - run record unreadable`, and `GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies` as verdicts, keeps usage 1/2 against caps 10/10 with no round or sync charged, refuses to reconstruct or search for the record in B, treats REVIEW_REQUIRED purely as a locator in C, and in all three puts stop recommended last, evidence in the trailing hint, no wait row, and merge explicitly not offered. The shared menus.md wording delivered the Change cleanly; keep the explicit 'exit check selects the obstacle before any CI watch, repair, or sync' sentence and the 'no round charged' annotation on deliver rows, since those are what distinguish the obstacle menu from the old per-action wait menu. One small guard worth keeping in future revisions: B says it 'marks the active continuation stage failed' — ensure that never implies writing to the unreadable record path.
